entries.intended_effect: make every tool inputSchema set additionalProperties:false
observed_benefit: some schema-validation and prompt-argument tasks become reliable in individual runs
observed_harm: held-out reliable tasks decrease in the independent replication
entries.suspected_conflict: a global schema imperative reallocates planning/checking attention even on tasks whose dominant requirement is lifecycle, state, pagination, prompt, or multi-client behavior

entries.intended_effect: prime strict schema behavior at Level 0
observed_benefit: prompt-template-render and multi-client-isolation pass all five diagnostic repeats
observed_harm: concurrent-state-isolation passes only four of five
higher token use than h0 on the diagnostic subset
entries.suspected_conflict: Level-0 priming broadens the scope of a local schema rule to every task invocation

entries.intended_effect: catch missing schema constraints before finalization
observed_benefit: prompt-template-render passes all five diagnostic repeats
observed_harm: cancellation, concurrency, and multi-client tasks become unstable
largest token total among tested diagnostic variants
entries.suspected_conflict: an unconditional pre-finish checklist adds global checking cost and may displace task-specific verification

entries.intended_effect: make tracked .gitignore a hard precondition before worktree creation
entries.suspected_conflict: the named gate added context but did not change the reliable task set or aggregates

entries.intended_effect: commit tracked ignore policy before worktree creation while preserving directory precedence
observed_benefit: independent replication gains default-hidden with no reliable loss
expanded-v3 gains default-hidden, dirty-worktree, failing-baseline, and submodule-guard with no reliable loss
observed_harm: total token use remains higher than h0
test-before-edit and test-after-edit behavior rates are lower in expanded-v3 despite higher task reliability
entries.suspected_conflict: no Q2 reliability conflict is observed in the valid replication or expanded-v3 run; increased context cost remains a Q3 tradeoff

entries.intended_effect: increase systematic rule/reference use without changing the canonical output contract
observed_benefit: official-full reliable held-in tasks increase from 0/6 to 2/6 relative to minimal
official-full uses deep references in 12/27 attempts
observed_harm: minimal reliable held-out secret-fallback-logging regresses from 3/3 to 2/3 under official-full
official-full instead gains signed-job-envelope, producing stable-task identity exchange hidden by equal held-out counts
entries.suspected_conflict: additional rule/reference context may reallocate attention toward some policy families while reducing evidence completeness on another family; this is a mechanism hypothesis, not causal proof

entries.intended_effect: make reproduce-before-edit and verification order observable
observed_benefit: test-before-first-edit increases to 9/9 from 7/9 minimal and 6/9 no-skill
observed_harm: no task-level separation: all variants pass the same 6/6 held-in and 2/3 held-out
official-full test-after-last-edit is 8/9 versus 9/9 for no-skill and minimal
official-full uses 332879 tokens versus 137642 no-skill in the one-repeat diagnostic
entries.suspected_conflict: the current fixtures are too easy for final correctness; stronger process order adds context and steps without creating capability headroom
